summary: Recent updates to the camera and audio capture features in Firefox now allow for **fractional framerate decimation**, enabling cameras to adjust their output more effectively to match the requested framerate on average. This means that when users engage in video calls or streaming, the camera can dynamically manage frame rates to provide smoother and more consistent video quality, even in varying lighting conditions or hardware limitations. This enhancement improves the overall user experience, making real-time communication feel more fluid and professional.
